headlines.text: Looking back to 2022, when Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta vs. Proud-N-Powerful & Kingston vs. Proud-N-Powerful vs. 2.O vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Ortiz vs. Santana vs. Eddie Kingston vs. Angelo Parker vs. Matt Menard vs. Chris Jericho vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Jake Hager vs. Sammy Guevara settled things in a Blood And Guts match, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 8.42 ? a real highlight of the night ? part of that year's Blood and Guts '22. Broken glass, barbed wire and a re-opened head wound from Forbidden Door all made appearances as Blackpool Combat Club and allies outlasted the Jericho Appreciation Society inside the double cage.

Back on this day in 2019, Jon Moxley vs. Joey Janela settled things in a Lights Out match, closing out the card as the main event on Fyter Fest, rated 7.98 ? a well-worked match ? part of that year's Fyter Fest '19. Moxley's in-ring AEW debut, an unsanctioned brawl through tables and thumbtacks that instantly washed away memories of his old WWE character ? the show closed with Kenny Omega ambushing Moxley afterward, smashing him with a Stratocaster and adding real spice to their feud.
That Saturday in 2024, Stephanie Vaquer stepped through the curtain for the first time against Lady Frost, appearing on Collision, rated 6.24.

secondaries.text: On a Saturday in 2024, back when Robbie Eagles made their AEW debut, appearing on Collision, rated 6.08.
That Saturday in 2019, The Elite vs. Lucha Brothers & Laredo Kid met for the very first time on Fyter Fest, rated 8.17 ? a fantastic contest.
On this day in 2022, Danhausen touched down in AEW for the first time against FTR & Gunn Club & Caster, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.44.
